name: vault
description: Vault, the local password service shared by Cosmic apps.

scripts.test: npm run build && node packages/core/test/run.mjs && node packages/service/test/run.mjs && node packages/app/test/run.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p packages/client --noEmit && tsc -p packages/service --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cli --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w vault-app
scripts.build: node scripts/build-helper.mjs && tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/client && tsc -p packages/service && tsc -p packages/cli && npm run build -w vault-app
